plain_summary_en: This paper studies Japanese Multiple Saying Iya Iya Iya as a Practice of Managing Persistence in Interaction. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is Iya, Japanese, Multiple, Saying. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
